ACF Summer Intensive Grant - February Submission
This is the original grant request submitted to the Arts Council Foundation in February 2026. It requests a restricted award of 75,000 to underwrite the summer intensive.
Budget narrative: the 75,000 request covers faculty stipends, scholarship seats, guest artist honoraria, accompanist fees, and showcase production for a planned forty-seat cohort.
Note for our files: the program office later revised the award during committee review. The 75,000 here is the original ask and is not the closeout figure.
Summer Intensive Board Packet - Draft Figures
Draft tuition assumption for board discussion: per-seat tuition of 2,800 across a forty-seat cohort. These board-packet numbers predate the final invoices and are for planning discussion only.
Planning target: forty enrolled seats. Final enrollment and collected tuition are reconciled separately against the invoices actually sent and the payments received.
Do not cite the 2,800 board-packet figure at closeout. The sent invoices carry the current per-seat number.
